maximum_depth_rule: All 89 canonical Phase 9 Reviewed statements from the registered overview PDF remain raw maximum-depth records until outcome indicators, values, periods, units, and table structures can be reviewed without inference.
source_gap_boundary: The landing audit selected two documents, while the canonical source registers one reviewed document and the Phase 9 summary records one extraction error. The missing document is not synthesized, counted as reviewed, or treated as error-free.
version_boundary: The current 2025-2032 comprehensive plan remains separate from the final evaluation of the former 2018-2024 plan. The resident-satisfaction survey monitors only some outcome indicators and is not a comprehensive plan evaluation.
non_goals: Do not fabricate or silently recover the unresolved selected document.
Do not reduce the registered extraction-error count from one to zero.
Do not inherit former-plan actuals or final evaluation into the current plan.
Do not treat resident-satisfaction monitoring as a comprehensive plan assessment.
Do not repair PDF control characters or split mixed values by inference.
Do not calculate achievement, causality, or cross-prefecture ranking.
